plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Mine Eazy uses your location to confirm you are inside your branch's geofence when you clock in or out.

extra._comment: Base URL of the bridge. The login screen can override it at runtime (persisted in the session), so a changed host needs no rebuild.
extra._comment_mobileKey: Must match MOBILE_PUNCH_KEY on the server (default: biobridge-mobile).
extra._comment_handsFree: Auto-clocking is disabled: employee clocks in/out directly via button.
